    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
        s = s + f.cfg_alignment_transaction_deficit * w[0]
    else:
        s = s + f.cfg_alignment_transaction_deficit * w[1]
    if p.log_min_dim < 7:
        s = s + np.log2(f.output_tile_edge_waste) * w[2]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(f.output_tile_edge_waste) * w[3]
    if p.reduction_parallelism_pressure > 1:
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[4]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[5]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[6]
    else:
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[7]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[8]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[9]
    s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_service_time_ratio) * w[10]
    s = s + f.cta_register_file_pressure * w[11]
    s = s + f.cta_smem_capacity_pressure * w[12]
    s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[13]
    s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[14]
    s = s + f.cta_compute_granularity_ratio * w[15]
    if p.log_flops < 30:
        s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_ratio * w[16]
        s = s + f.grid_residency_deficit * w[17]
    else:
        s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_ratio * w[18]
        s = s + f.grid_residency_deficit * w[19]
    if p.operand_l2_pressure > 1:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.a_refetch_bw_demand) * w[20]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[21]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_hz_ratio) * w[22]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_id_ratio) * w[23]
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[24]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.a_refetch_bw_demand) * w[25]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[26]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_hz_ratio) * w[27]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_id_ratio) * w[28]
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[29]
    if p.output_l2_pressure > 1:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[30]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[31]
    else:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[32]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[33]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + np.log2(f.edge_padded_work_ratio) * w[0]
    s = s + f.launch_wave_tail_fraction * w[1]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[2]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[3]
    s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_depth_time_ratio) * w[4]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.tile_grid_aspect_mismatch) * w[15]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_warp_orientation_mismatch) * w[16]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.tile_grid_aspect_mismatch) * np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_warp_orientation_mismatch) * w[17]
    if p.mn_aspect_imbalance > 4.0:
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[13]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_thread_work_ratio) * w[14]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.input_load_coalescing_pressure) * w[5]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.output_store_coalescing_pressure) * w[6]
        s = s + (f.a_refetch_bw_demand + f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[7]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * w[8]
        s = s + p.alignment_transaction_penalty * (np.log2(1.0 + f.input_load_coalescing_pressure) + np.log2(1.0 + f.output_store_coalescing_pressure)) * w[7]
    else:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[9]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[10]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[11]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.cta_thread_work_ratio) * w[12]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.instruction_amortization_density * w[0]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.mainloop_barrier_count) * w[1]
    if p.log_min_dim < 8.0 or p.output_parallelism_deficit > 1.0e-4:
        s = s + f.tiled_boundary_traffic_ratio * w[2]
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[3]
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[4]
        s = s + f.cta_wave_padding_ratio * w[5]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[6]
        s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[7]
    else:
        s = s + f.tiled_boundary_traffic_ratio * w[8]
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[9]
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[10]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[11]
        s = s + f.output_store_stride_exposure * w[12]
        s = s + np.where(f.a_refetch_bw_demand >= f.b_refetch_bw_demand,
                         f.operand_reuse_imbalance * f.cta_roofline_traffic_ratio,
                         0.0) * w[13]
        s = s + np.where(f.a_refetch_bw_demand < f.b_refetch_bw_demand,
                         f.operand_reuse_imbalance * f.cta_roofline_traffic_ratio,
                         0.0) * w[14]
    else:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[15]
    if p.alignment_traffic_deficit > 0.0:
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[16]
    else:
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[17]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 1.0e-4:
        s = s + f.cta_register_file_pressure * w[18]
        s = s + f.cta_shared_memory_pressure * w[19]
        s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[20]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[21]
    else:
        s = s + f.cta_register_file_pressure * w[22]
        s = s + f.cta_shared_memory_pressure * w[23]
        s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[24]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[25]
    if p.reduction_depth_ratio > 1.0:
        if p.pipeline_latency_occupancy_time_ratio > 1.0:
            s = s + f.pipeline_stage_overhead_fraction * w[26]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[27]
        else:
            s = s + f.pipeline_stage_overhead_fraction * w[28]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[29]
    else:
        if p.pipeline_latency_occupancy_time_ratio > 1.0:
            s = s + f.pipeline_stage_overhead_fraction * w[30]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[31]
        else:
            s = s + f.pipeline_stage_overhead_fraction * w[32]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[33]
    raster_dram = np.log2(1.0 + np.where(
        f.a_refetch_bw_demand >= f.b_refetch_bw_demand,
        f.dram_w1_hz_ratio,
        f.dram_w1_id_ratio))
    if p.gemm_working_set_l2_pressure < 1.0:
        s = s + f.raster_panel_turnover_rate * w[34]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + 1000.0 * f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * w[35]
        s = s + f.raster_panel_turnover_rate * raster_dram * w[36]
    else:
        s = s + f.raster_panel_turnover_rate * w[37]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + 1000.0 * f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * w[38]
        s = s + f.raster_panel_turnover_rate * raster_dram * w[39]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[0]
    s = s + np.log2(f.operand_panel_transaction_amplification) * w[1]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.barrier_arrival_density) * w[2]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + f.operand_tile_padding_ratio * w[3]
        s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_deficit * w[4]
    else:
        s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[5]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[6]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.pipeline_depth_time_ratio) * w[7]
    s = s + np.where(
        f.tm_regstaged > 0.5,
        np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log),
        np.log2(1.0 + f.shared_memory_pressure) + f.occupancy_deficit
    ) * w[8]
    s = s + np.where(
        f.tm_regstaged > 0.5,
        np.log2(f.tm_crit_ratio),
        np.log2(1.0 + f.shared_memory_pressure) + f.occupancy_deficit
    ) * w[9]
    if p.relative_reduction_depth > 2.0 and p.log_min_dim < 9.0:
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[10]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[11]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log) * w[12]
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[13]
    else:
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[14]
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[15]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[16]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log) * w[17]
    return s
